name: Generic choice tasks
description: Everyday classification tasks with a defensible gold label: sentiment, news topic, language identification, support routing and factual multiple choice. Items are marked clear or ambiguous so order effects can be compared between easy and borderline cases.

sentiment.instructions: What is the overall sentiment of this text?

options.description: Factual or without a clear emotional stance
Clearly contains both positive and negative judgements

news_topic.instructions: Which section of a news site does this text belong in?

language.instructions: In which language is this text written?

support_routing.instructions: Which team should handle this customer message?

options.description: Bugs, errors, the product not working
Delivery, tracking, parcels, returns in transit
Anything that fits none of the teams above

factual.instructions: Which option correctly answers the question in the text?

options.description: The first answer listed in the text
The second answer listed in the text
The third answer listed in the text
The fourth answer listed in the text

factual_named.instructions: What is the capital city of the country mentioned in the text?
